parties.respondent: Dipak Kumar Saha (Dead) through Lrs. & Others

summary: Validity of sale deed executed via Power of Attorney; burden of proof on title; absence of PoA not excused by endorsement in sale deed; statutory presumption under Registration Act not applicable without PoA compliance; foreign PoA non-production fatal; concurrent trial and appellate court dismissal upheld against High Court reversal; possession claim fails absent clear title.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 6 of the Specific Relief Act
Prem Singh and others v. Birbal and others (2006) 5 SCC 353
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; decree of trial court and first appellate court restored; plaintiffs' suit dismissed.
